summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney, which now formats with Intl.NumberFormat in a caller-chosen currency. invoiceLines gains a currency parameter that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed export still imported by cart.ts
findings.problem: This change renames the export formatPrice to formatMoney. src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice and calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails on the missing export. If the build does not run, the cart total call throws at runtime.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Alternatively, keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed formatting behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: invoiceLines now takes a currency argument, and formatMoney now formats through Intl.NumberFormat. The repository has no test file that exercises either function.
findings.consequence: Nothing would catch regressions in currency output or in callers of the renamed function.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines with the default USD currency and with a non-USD currency.
